servers.title: Observability reader
servers.description: Read metrics, logs, traces and alerts for diagnosis.

servers.title: Knowledge and topology
servers.description: Query the service graph, recent changes, runbooks and past incidents.
servers.identity: read-only on graph, search indexes and memory

servers.title: Kubernetes executor
servers.description: Workload operations on managed Kubernetes clusters.

servers.title: Compute and database executor
servers.description: Instance, managed database and feature-flag operations.
servers.identity: scoped role per project or account

servers.title: Delivery executor
servers.description: Infrastructure-as-code plans, applies and release controls.
servers.identity: CI/CD service identity with plan/apply split

servers.title: ITSM executor
servers.description: Incident, change and request records in the service management tool.

servers.title: Approvals and collaboration
servers.description: Human-in-the-loop approval cards and notifications in chat.

servers.title: FinOps executor
servers.description: Cost, quota and rightsizing data and actions.
servers.identity: billing viewer plus scoped compute rightsizing

servers.title: Access executor
servers.description: Time-bound, conditional access grants for service requests.
servers.identity: can assign only pre-approved, time-bound roles; cannot create roles

servers.title: Platform control (operators only)
servers.description: Controls over the agent platform itself. Never callable by agents.
servers.identity: operator group via privileged access with justification

tools.name: obs.query_metrics
tools.description: Query a time series (PromQL or the native query language) over a window.
tools.gcp: Cloud Monitoring / Managed Service for Prometheus

tools.name: obs.search_logs
tools.description: Search logs with a filter and return redacted matches.
tools.notes: Results are untrusted content and are screened by G4 before reaching the model.

tools.name: obs.get_trace
tools.description: Fetch a distributed trace by ID with span timings and errors.

tools.name: obs.list_alerts
tools.description: List open alerts and SLO burn rates for a service.
tools.aws: CloudWatch alarms and Application Signals SLOs

tools.name: kb.get_topology
tools.description: Return upstream and downstream dependencies, owners and criticality for a service.

tools.name: kb.recent_changes
tools.description: List deployments, config and infrastructure changes affecting a service in a window.
tools.gcp: Cloud Audit Logs, Cloud Deploy, Cloud Asset Inventory

tools.name: kb.search_runbooks
tools.description: Hybrid search over runbooks, postmortems and architecture docs, filtered by the requester's entitlements.

tools.name: kb.similar_incidents
tools.description: Retrieve past incidents similar to the current one, with their resolutions.
tools.gcp: Agent Engine Memory Bank, Vector Search

tools.name: k8s.restart_pods
tools.description: Rolling restart of a deployment's pods.

tools.name: k8s.scale_deployment
tools.description: Set replica count, bounded by a maximum change percentage from policy.

tools.name: k8s.rollback_deployment
tools.description: Roll a deployment back to its previous revision.

tools.name: compute.restart_instance
tools.description: Restart a VM instance that is part of a managed group.
tools.aws: Amazon EC2 via Systems Manager Automation

tools.name: db.failover
tools.description: Fail a managed database over to its standby or replica.

tools.name: flags.set_feature_flag
tools.description: Toggle a feature flag to disable a faulty code path.
tools.gcp: Firebase Remote Config or your flag service

tools.name: delivery.pause_rollout
tools.description: Pause an in-progress progressive rollout.

tools.name: delivery.rollback_release
tools.description: Roll a release back to the last known-good version.

tools.name: iac.plan
tools.description: Produce an infrastructure-as-code plan and a risk summary without applying it.
tools.aws: CloudFormation change sets / Terraform in CodeBuild

tools.name: iac.apply
tools.description: Apply a previously generated and approved plan, by plan ID only.
tools.notes: Applies only plans produced by iac.plan; free-form infrastructure changes are not possible.

tools.name: itsm.create_incident
tools.description: Open an incident linked to the trace ID.
tools.gcp: ServiceNow or Jira via Integration Connectors
tools.aws: ServiceNow or Jira via AgentCore Gateway target

tools.name: itsm.update_incident
tools.description: Add work notes, change status or resolve with an RCA summary.
tools.gcp: ServiceNow or Jira via Integration Connectors
tools.aws: ServiceNow or Jira via AgentCore Gateway target

tools.name: itsm.open_change
tools.description: Open a change request with plan, risk score, blast radius and rollback.
tools.aws: ServiceNow, Jira or SSM Change Manager

tools.name: hitl.request_approval
tools.description: Send an interactive approval card to the owning group and wait durably for a decision.
tools.aws: Slack or Teams cards + Step Functions task tokens
tools.notes: Separation of duties is enforced; the requester can never approve.

tools.name: chat.post_update
tools.description: Post a status update to an incident channel.

tools.name: finops.cost_breakdown
tools.description: Cost by service, label or tag over a period, with anomalies.
tools.aws: Cost Explorer / CUR in S3 Tables

tools.name: finops.apply_rightsizing
tools.description: Apply a provider rightsizing recommendation to a non-production resource.

tools.name: sec.enrich_finding
tools.description: Enrich a security finding with asset, identity and threat-intelligence context.

tools.name: sec.isolate_workload
tools.description: Isolate a workload by applying a deny network tag or quarantine security group.
tools.gcp: Cloud NGFW secure tags via SecOps SOAR
tools.aws: Security group swap via Step Functions playbook

tools.name: access.grant_temporary
tools.description: Grant a pre-approved role to a user on a resource for a bounded time, on behalf of that user.
tools.gcp: IAM conditional bindings / Privileged Access Manager
tools.aws: IAM Identity Center permission sets with expiry
tools.notes: Only roles on the entitlement catalogue; owner, admin and organisation roles are forbidden by policy.

tools.name: platform.set_kill_switch
tools.description: Disable an agent or an action type platform-wide.

tools.name: platform.set_autonomy_level
tools.description: Promote or demote an action type's autonomy level after the promotion checklist.
tools.gcp: Policy bundle in Git, deployed by Cloud Build
tools.aws: Cedar policy in Git, deployed to AgentCore Policy

tools.name: platform.run_evaluation
tools.description: Run the offline evaluation suite for an agent version against its golden set.
tools.gcp: Vertex AI Pipelines + Gen AI Evaluation Service
